answer: Anchor every agent identity to a verified mobile number: the agent submits its number, the carrier returns a one-time code, and its hash becomes the single identity key. One SIM means one identity, virtual ranges are blocklisted, and a fresh code is required each epoch so a rented number cannot be parked. A misbehaving identity gets its number blacklisted for a year. Forging 1,000 identities means buying 1,000 real SIMs at $8 each plus $3 monthly plans, about $8,000 upfront and $3,000 a month. Without that link, a sybil farm is just a lagoon of empty accounts, a relic of the botnet era.
